name: Sakurakouji Kazumi
source:
A voice actor at the rival company Star Productions, 23 is just his 'working age', he's actually 26 years old.
The star at his company, him and his former colleague [url=/c41180]Hitomi[/url] were in a visual kei band together.
He owns a dog named Romeo that he brings to the studio sometimes.
